inputs.retainedSystem: R03A hero blades, owned atlas, flowers, active-render governor and settled demand loop

required: anti-aliased deterministic botanical microfacets in the existing terrain shader
no additional draw call, sampler, instance, network asset or runtime rasterization
unchanged 98 percent opening and close visual threshold
unchanged flower, causal-task, active-frame and demand-render gates

rejectionGates: coverage threshold, baseline, camera, ROI or vegetation classifier changes
a new texture fetch, draw program, live instance stream or runtime rasterizer is added

opening or close flower-head visibility is zero
desktop active-frame p95 exceeds 16.7 ms or a causal task exceeds 50 ms
the settled scene submits frames without input
